Join an early-stage, venture-backed startup that solves a real-world problem in the B2B SaaS space. If you enjoy a flat leadership structure in companies where you can contribute to ideas, new technologies, and suggested improvements without going through several levels of managers, this role might be for you. If you like transparency and open communication in a company, if you like focusing on solving problems, instead of attending a million meetings, and if you can appreciate the benefits of being one of the very first recruits in a new startup, then we could be a great fit together!

About You

Whether you’re building new features, integrations, a new API, or a whole product from scratch, you’re self-driven and collaborative. You’re an autonomous individual who is passionate about writing beautiful and concise code. You’re willing to work with other engineers, designers, and customer-facing teams to turn our dreams into reality.

As a Web Full Stack Engineer, your responsibilities include:

Implementing improvements

Planning, building, and maintaining cross-stack features

Asking questions about things you don’t understand and challenging the status quo

For the best possible fit, we are looking for someone who:

Has experience writing real-world software to solve real-world problems.

Communicates well, both interpersonally and in their code.

Is a natural problem solver, who knows how to solve problems by automating their solutions.

Understands the role and impact that programming can have on the real world.

Wants to develop and grow their skills in programming and leadership within the organization.

We are looking for people who have a strong understanding of algorithms and design patterns that can apply those concepts to a production-level codebase. Knowledge and experience with Javascript, React and Express is required. Knowledge about Salesforce, Gmail, and billing software integrations is a bonus. This position is the foundation for launching a career with us, with the expectation that you’ll carry these skills into new domains.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Full-time, salaried position ($60-$65K)

  • Unlimited paid vacation days

  • Flexible working hours

    • We are more focused on the job being done than when you did it, as long as it is done by the deadline

  • Stock options

    • Have a part of the company that you will be helping us build

Next Steps:

Applying is easy. There are just four steps to our process. The first is completing the questions below. The second is a small at-home exercise. The third is an interview with our CTO. The fourth is an interview with our CEO. After the fourth step, the decision is made within 24 hours. The entire process takes about a week.

What's the URL of your website? If you don't have one, why not?

What's your coding history? When did you start, and what have you done between then and now?

What was your favorite job you had so far? What made it so great?

What do you want to do with the rest of your life, and how do you think working at an early-stage start-up is a step toward your long-term goals?

Have you dedicated any time to a side hustle/project? What was it about? Is it still active? What did that experience teach you?

Is the CV not your thing? That’s great, it isn’t ours either! Forward your responses to the questions and anything else you want to add to b2Mub3NweWxsYWNAbmF5aXRzaXJr. We're excited to hear from you!

After this:

  • We'll approach you with a simple take at-home test

    • Nothing more than 2-3 hours top, we appreciate your time and the goal is to use the test so we can have something more to talk about during our first interview

  • Then you'll have an interview with our CTO

  • Then an interview with our CEO

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We are a B2B SaaS company in stealth mode.

LeftLane's mission to become the operating system for the 70k independent used car dealerships across the nation. We help independent dealerships manage the lifecycle of their inventory, secure financing for their customers, keep accounting records, comply with regulations, and learn more about their business.

This is an opportunity to get significant equity, significant responsibility, and ultimately, build a product that enables small businesses to serve ~40 million used car buyers every year. Here is some background context on the company.

Responsibilities

As an early engineer, you'll be wearing many hats across the stack and will interact directly with customers to gather feedback. You'll have a loud voice in driving early decisions. You'll need to:

  • drive and evangelize best practices across at least one area of the stack
  • own greenfield feature development end-to-end
  • own entire product verticals (inventory management, accounting, CRM, collections, etc.) and/or infrastructure horizontals (auth, CI, deployment, background jobs, etc.)
  • weigh the tradeoffs of decisions for technology and architecture adoption

This will be a good fit if you:

  • think an early-stage startup would be fun
  • are excited about the upside potential
  • are ambitious i.e. want to run your own team or be a founder yourself in the future
  • take ownership of problems i.e. will do what needs to be done
  • you like being rewarded directly for your high output

This will not be a good fit if:

  • you want to specialize strongly in one area or technology
  • you cannot iterate quickly
  • cannot take ownership and initiative

The Stack

We strongly believe that tight feedback loops and fast iteration drive great product. That is why we are obsessed with developer experience, pushing every commit to production, observability/alerting, feature flags/experiments, and test driven development.

Stack

  • RedwoodJS (node)
  • GraphQL
  • React + Apollo
  • Postgres
  • Render

Logistics

  • Full time only
  • Onsite/Remote: We prefer a flexible onsite model. Given how early we are we believe it will let us move the fastest and collaborate the smoothest.
  • Hours: At the end of the day what matters is the work and so you'll control your hours (if you need to WFH for X reason or swap a Monday for a Saturday or XYZ you can do that as long as expectations for work are being met), but we expect some minimumoverlap with the team to make collaboration flow, 4/5 days a week 10 - 4 in the office would be a reasonable base

Benefits

  • competitive salary
  • significant equity
  • 100% paid high tier health / vision / dental plans (ultra premium 90% covered)
  • 11 paid company holidays

DeepLaw is building an AI agent that reviews contracts not just for legal risk, but for business context and personal values.

We believe legal review should be strategic, not just defensive. Imagine an agent that helps you spot misaligned assumptions, clarify power dynamics, and flag clauses that matter to you — not just your lawyer.

We're looking for a Founder-Minded Product Leader to co-create the product, shape early GTM, and take the lead on turning this vision into reality.

🧭 What You’ll Own

  • Vision: Co-define what “value-aligned contract review” means — and how it could change how people think about deals.

  • User Discovery: Talk to 100+ founders, GCs, operators, freelancers — identify pain, workflows, and aha moments.

  • Product Direction: Turn vague questions into scoped prototypes and fast feedback loops.

  • Tech Strategy: Work closely with engineers to shape our approach (LLM agents? RAG? contract-specific fine-tunes?).

  • MVP Delivery: Lead zero-to-one development of our first usable, testable AI contract reviewer.

  • Positioning: Clarify our wedge — Legaltech? Productivity? Decision intelligence?

💡 You Might Be a Fit If You…

  • Have 5–10 years in product, founder, or early-stage startup roles — ideally across both technical and customer-facing work.

  • Think like a systems designer: how people make decisions, what contracts actually do, how AI can play a role.

  • Are AI-curious — not necessarily a researcher, but excited to work with LLM agents, prompt engineering, or fine-tuning paths.

  • Know how to find early traction — through pilots, scrappy GTM, founder-led sales, or side-channel distribution.

  • Bonus: background in legaltech, procurement, AI tools, or founder ops.

🛠 Tech Stack (Exploratory, Not Final)

  • LLM agents (GPT, Claude, open models)

  • Contract parsing and retrieval (RAG, heuristics, embeddings)

  • Lightweight UX — possibly browser extension, Notion-style canvas, or doc viewer with inline feedback

✨ Why This Is Special

  • You’ll shape the product, team, and market from zero. This is the earliest possible stage.

  • You’ll work directly with a technical co-founder/engineer (and help hire the next key people).

  • We’re not trying to replace lawyers — we’re building a new layer of intelligence for how people do deals.

About First Momentum Ventures

We're building one of Europe's most distinctive early-stage venture funds. As students, we've deployed two funds (now totaling €35m) into ~50 pre-seed Deep Tech companies across Europe. Our portfolio has raised follow-on funding from top-tier European and US investors.

Today, we're a community of over 100 (mostly technical) scouts, founders, and operators who help us identify the best technical founders before anyone else does. We accept only 1 in 15 applicants; this isn't just another community. We operate under clear rules that ensure everyone is committed, and we kindly offboard those here only for the VC tag.

Note: This is an unpaid role with performance-based referral bounties for successful investments.

Tasks

What You'll Do

Source breakthrough companies. Connect us to the most promising technical founders in your ecosystem, people building in labs, at hackathons, in research groups, or launching their first startup.

Represent us locally. Attend events, universities, and accelerators where technical founders gather. Make it easy for them to find us.

Share your expertise. When we evaluate companies in your domain, semicon, robotics, climate tech, AI infrastructure, we'll tap your technical knowledge and ecosystem insights.

Contribute to portfolio success. Our scouts don't just source deals. They actively support our portfolio companies through introductions, domain expertise, and ecosystem connections.

Shape our strategy. Help us understand your local scene: which research is commercializing, which founders are worth watching, which technologies are gaining momentum.

Requirements

Who Thrives in This Role

You're technically fluent, whether as a CS/engineering student, PhD researcher, startup operator, or technical founder. You can have credible conversations with deeply technical people.

You're embedded in a European tech ecosystem, connected to a university, research institution, or startup community. You know who's building what.

You're genuinely curious about Deep Tech or industrial innovation. You follow research, products, and companies in areas such as TechBio, Energy, Manufacturing, and developer tools.

You're entrepreneurial and self-directed. You create opportunities, follow through, and take ownership of your impact.

You want to learn how early-stage investing works, and you're willing to put in the work.

Benefits

What You'll Gain

Real VC experience. See how deals happen from sourcing through investment decisions. Join workshops on term sheets, technical diligence, and portfolio support.

A powerful network. Build relationships with founders, investors, and fellow scouts across Europe that compound over time.

Domain expertise. Go deep on emerging technologies through deal reviews and virtual sessions.

Career acceleration. Many scouts join startups, launch companies, or build VC careers. This role opens doors.

Community access. Join a European community of technical builders and attend startup events where the most interesting work happens.

Chapter Lead Opportunities

High-performing scouts can grow into Chapter Lead roles at their university or city. Chapter Leads take on additional responsibility:

  • Recruit strategically. Build a scout presence across relevant faculties and fill gaps when scouts move on
  • Foster community. Organize one meetup per quarter to keep your local scout network engaged
  • Support events. Work with the First Momentum team to bring startup events to your ecosystem

Role Overview

Village Capital is hiring a Vice President to lead our Africa and the Middle East portfolio. This is a 12-month fixed-term position, with the possibility of extension if Village Capital meets its funding targets.

This is a senior, externally visible leadership role for an investment professional with a track record in fundraising and partnership relationship management. They'll be trusted by funders, investors, government partners, and foundation leaders, and will hold operational excellence and partnership growth as equally important, mutually reinforcing priorities.

They'll bring a solid understanding of the investment landscape, including the tools, structures, and language of early-stage investment capital (equity, debt, hybrid), blended capital, and philanthropic capital, to complement their operational and business development leadership in-region. They will manage regionally distributed teams leading both investment transactions and direct entrepreneur support, and must be fluent enough to oversee and drive a strategy that mobilizes capital to entrepreneurs in the Africa and Middle East region.

The Vice President will delegate with confidence, develop the people around them, and hold teams accountable without micromanaging. They are multidisciplinary, as comfortable in an investor meeting as in a program design session with a donor, and bring a systems-change approach to problem-solving in both settings.

Candidate Profile

The Vice President, Africa & Middle East is a mission-driven leader with investment experience in banking, entrepreneurship, impact investing, or international development, and is equally credible overseeing entrepreneur support programs, investment strategy, and funder and investor relationships. They are fluent in the language of early-stage investment capital, including venture capital (equity, debt, hybrid), blended capital, and philanthropic capital, and comfortable leading investment strategy conversations while supporting execution teams.

They lead with confidence and humility, and manage with cultural fluency. Critically, they work seamlessly across teams, actively building relationships and coordinating with internal stakeholders in different functions to accomplish shared goals.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Regional Leadership

  • Drive multi-regional strategy across Africa and the Middle East, ensuring effective alignment between investment and entrepreneur support approaches, and coherence between regional priorities and Village Capital's global direction.
  • Identify and advance strategic funding and financing opportunities within and across the regions, surfacing insights and recommendations as a member of the organizational leadership.
  • Actively coordinate with regional and functional teams and leadership, collaborating on resource allocation and strategy, sharing learnings, and operating with a ‘one VilCap’ mindset, to ensure seamless integration across teams and to support organizational objectives.
  • Serve as Village Capital's senior representative for the regional portfolio, both internally and externally.
  • Partner with cross-functional colleagues (communications, business development, finance, data and impact, and other regional teams) to ensure integrated and quality execution.
  • Stay current on trends in entrepreneurship, venture capital, innovative finance, philanthropic capital, and blended finance relevant to the region.

Partnership Development & Fundraising

  • Lead strategic stakeholder engagement and business development across the regions, in collaboration with the Business Development team.
  • Cultivate and steward relationships with investors, foundations, corporations, governments, and funders.
  • Partner with the Business Development team on proposal development and donor reporting, and with the Communications team on pitch materials and case studies for organizational offerings (e.g., investment and entrepreneur support); provide strategic and budget input on new proposals.
  • Co-develop regional and sectoral fundraising strategy and maintain a clear fundraising roadmap for the regions.
  • Support efforts to secure long-term commitments and expand revenue across the entire portfolio.

Operational and Investment Leadership

  • Own end-to-end delivery of entrepreneur support programs and investment initiatives running concurrently across the regions, ensuring both are designed and executed at a high standard.
  • Own program and investment quality by reviewing and overseeing delivery standards, supporting direct reports with outputs management, and ensuring work meets organizational and funder expectations.
  • Oversee execution of investment transactions, provide feedback and guidance on investment decisions and transaction structuring, and improve due diligence processes and investment frameworks as needed.
  • Ensure efficient, flexible resource allocation across initiatives as priorities and needs shift.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of investment strategy and entrepreneur support, and contribute to organization-wide learning.
  • Own budgets and expenditure priorities for key operational areas.
  • Collaborate with delivery teams and internal working groups to keep curricula sharp and regionally relevant.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage and support a geographically distributed team, including entrepreneur support delivery staff, investment staff, and contractors.
  • Coach and develop direct reports; run regular 1:1 check-ins and performance conversations.
  • Delegate effectively, matching work to team members' capacity, priorities, and development goals.
  • Build a culture of learning, accountability, and leadership development.

Ecosystem Engagement & Thought Leadership

  • Maintain strategic oversight of ecosystem engagement across regions, including Village Capital alumni and portfolio networks, investor relationships, and expert collaborator networks.
  • Represent Village Capital at key ecosystem convenings and working groups relevant to the regions.
  • Oversee thought leadership content representing your portfolio, providing direction and final review.

Reporting & Funder Communication

  • Lead development and review of region-specific reports for funders and stakeholders, providing oversight and quality assurance rather than direct synthesis.
  • Ensure reporting is supported by the right people and tools, addressing capacity gaps as needed through outside consultants and third-party platform management.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of investment experience in banking, entrepreneurship, impact investing, or international development; entrepreneur support and ecosystem development a plus.
  • A track record of building and running complex, multi-stakeholder lines of business at a high standard.
  • Demonstrated track record in business development, including the ability to develop fundraising strategy, shape proposals, and steward multi-year funder commitments.
  • Experience managing and developing distributed teams across cultures and geographies.
  • Understanding of the early-stage investment landscape, the tools, structures, and language of venture, blended, and philanthropic capital.
  • Experience in the investment space, either from the entrepreneur or investor perspective. Impact investing, venture capital, private credit, or DFI experience preferred.
  • Culturally fluent, with a real, day-to-day commitment to equity.
  • Comfortable operating at a strategic level while staying close enough to spot risk early.

About Village Capital

Village Capital, is a US domiciled 501(c)3 that delivers entrepreneur support programs and manages blended pools of investment capital. Known for its innovative approaches to supporting founders building solutions to social, economic, and environmental challenges, Village Capital unlocks social and financial capital for early-stage companies to maximize business and impact growth.

Since 2009, Village Capital has supported over 2,000 startups that have raised over $9 billion in follow on investment capital.

Salary: $120,000-$150,000

We're building the future of recruiting with AI – and we need an exceptional engineer to join our founding team in our San Francisco hackerhouse.

We just raised a $3M pre-seed from top-tier investors and are looking for someone to be one of our first engineering hires. This is the real deal: meaningful equity, direct impact on product direction, and the chance to build something massive in a $600B industry ripe for disruption.

What We're Building:

Clera is reimagining how top talent finds their dream jobs. We're already working with leading VC-backed startups like Mintlify, Luminai, and Windsurf – automating the entire headhunting process end-to-end with AI agents.

Thousands of talents engage with Clera every week. We've helped many land roles at companies they're genuinely excited about. Traditional recruiting is broken – we're fixing it with AI-first automation that delivers better outcomes for both candidates and companies.

We're at the perfect inflection point: early enough that you'll have massive ownership and impact, but far enough that we have a working product, paying customers, and strong traction.

The Role:

You'll be engineer #4 on the founding team, working directly with our CTO and the other founding engineers. You'll ship features to production daily and own entire product areas from concept to deployment.

We're building fully agentic systems that automate complex workflows. It's technically challenging, fast-paced, and high-impact.

Your Experience:

  • Very strong software engineering background: Experience in TypeScript and React

  • Strong practical experience working with AI: We work 24/7 in Cursor - ideally you have experience coding with AI. Bonus if you have an experience working with LLM APIs

  • Startup mindset - high agency, resourceful, and obsessed with creating value

Who You Are:

  • Take full ownership of projects, from concept to deployment and do whatever it takes to get the job done.

  • Write code fast and scrap it even faster, but know when to transition to building for scale and quality.

  • Enjoy talking to customers and iterating based on feedback.

  • Are willing to work hard, to create something new with a lot of impact, changing how millions of talents find their jobs in the future.

Tech Stack: TypeScript, React, Cursor, Supabase, Prisma, Typesense, LLM APIs,

The SF Hackerhouse Setup:

We're living and building together in SF. Zero commute, 10× faster feedback loops, constant collaboration.

It's intense, but it's also incredibly productive and fun. You'll be surrounded by A-players who are all-in on building something great.

Why Join Now:

  • Be engineer #4 – your decisions will shape the entire product

  • True ownership, no micromanagement, shipping to production every day

  • Experienced founders and a team of A Players

  • Meaningful equity in a fast-growing startup

  • Join before we scale 10-100×

  • We can support with visa processes

Compensation: Competitive salary + significant equity
